comment: DEP-05 "Quorum expiry": a QuorumBegin's quorum_expiry must not exceed the shortest membership_until among the members it seats (members with no commitment impose none). An operator proposes min(current_block + its window, that ceiling). A QuorumBegin whose quorum_expiry is at or below its block_height (current_block) is non-conforming: born expired; an operator whose plan is not after the block (rotatable false) collects fresh consents first. Shared with deposits-rust (deposits-protocol/tests/vectors/quorum_expiry.json).

cases.name: soak 2026-10-24: a 30-day window past the shortest commitment is cut to it
every commitment beyond the window: the window stands
members without a commitment impose none
no member committed: no ceiling, the window stands
born_expired: soak 2026-10-28, stale commitments below the block
expiry_at_block: a commitment ending at the block is already lapsed
one block after the block is the earliest valid expiry
